Alyssa: Heads-up — Today is Caffeine Pseudonym Day! Put a pseudonym sticker on your mug and drop the name here. Winner gets a sticker pack. :coffee:
Ben: Ooh rules? Is decaf allowed? :thinking:
Alyssa: No fairness rules. Bonus points for puns. I'll start: 'CodeBrew'
Chris: 'StackLatte' I'm claiming it. Also made a tiny poll: react :one: for CodeBrew, :two: for StackLatte, :three: for Cache&Cream, :four: for NullPointer
Hana: I'll never lose 'NullPointer' — it's eternal. :joy:
Mika: Proposing 'HeapOverflow' — too on-the-nose? :shrug:
Ben: `StackLatte` +1. Also adding 'MutableMug' as a write-in.
Alyssa: Love 'HeapOverflow' and 'MutableMug' — okay, official write-in thread below. Stickers on the way for the top 2.
deploy-bot: Reminder: sticker budget approved by Finance. :white_check_mark: (reaction :tada:)
Chris: Also, whoever uses 'Decaf' loses privileges to complain about meetings. :laughing:
Hana: Vote results so far: :one: 3, :two: 5, :three: 1 (me), :four: 2, write-ins: HeapOverflow, MutableMug.
Mika: Thread summary: choose a mug name, stick it, brag in #general. Winner gets a sticker pack + kudos. :tada:
Ben: Putting a tiny sign on the kitchen whiteboard: 'Declare your pseudonym here' — will check at 4pm.
Alyssa: :thumbsup: thanks y'all. Can't wait to see the chaos.
